title: Agent predictions, version 0
description: What an agent actually produced for each of its gold set's cases, as the same canonical string items eval.yaml expects — never committed alongside the gold set it is scored against, produced fresh by the agent's own wrapper on each change.

run.description: What produced this: a model id, a git ref, a timestamp — whatever identifies the run for a human reading the report.

predictions.description: Case id to the items the agent produced for it; a case with no key is unscored and reported as missing, not as an empty prediction.
